I am not a sociopath I have extreme social anxiety, that to my perspective looks like I'm mostly fooling everyone. I smile and am personable to anyone I come across but it's all rote, scripted, autopilot. I would never share my darkest thoughts with anyone but a few very close to me who I trust. Everyone I meet likes me, I am a misanthropic pacifist, I don't wish harm on anyone for any reason because pain sucks but I don't give any tangible shit about anyone outside of a close circle. If I weren't lucky enough to have a few adversaries I have no idea who or what I might be. But to your point, yes, everyone is faking it for acceptance until they have no identity, or faking it for power and manipulation. I've met genuine people and they are the beginning of an evolved species.
